Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.intro:
Alesyo Win LTD (company number 16737234), having its registered office at 54 Market Street, Eastleigh, SO50 5RB, United Kingdom, operates the website www.ALESYOWIN.com and is responsible for managing all competitions listed there.

For any questions or concerns, you can contact us by email at info@ALESYOWIN.com.

s1.title: 1. General Rules
s1.content:
1.1 Every competition published on www.ALESYOWIN.com is governed by these Terms & Conditions ("T&Cs"). They cover both standard prize draw competitions ("Standard Competitions") and instant win competitions ("Instant Win Competitions"), referred to collectively as "Competitions."
1.2 These T&Cs take precedence over any other communication — including any promotional material, social media posts, or other communications relating to a Competition.
1.3 To be eligible for a prize, participants must correctly answer a question or solve a problem set by Alesyo Win LTD (the "Competition Question").
1.4 Each Competition includes a Competition Question. A paid entry fee applies to each time you enter. Where Alesyo Win LTD offers a multiple-choice or easy-to-answer question, a free postal entry route is also available.

s2.title: 2. How to Enter
s2.content:
2.1 Each Competition runs between the start and end dates shown on the relative competition page of www.ALESYOWIN.com ("Opening Date" and "Closing Date"). All dates and times refer to the time in London, England.
2.2 Alesyo Win LTD reserves the right to adjust opening or closing dates if truly necessary. Any changes will be updated on the website promptly.
2.3 All entries must reach us by the specified closing time. Entries received after this moment are automatically invalid. No refunds will be given for late entries.
2.4 Every Competition has a maximum ticket limit, displayed on the competition page. Once this limit is reached, no more entries will be accepted.
2.5 There is also an entry limit per person for each Competition. This limit is stated on the individual competition page.
2.6 To enter a Standard Competition via the paid route: visit www.ALESYOWIN.com, choose the competition, answer the Competition Question, choose how many entries you want, proceed to checkout, login or register if needed, accept these T&Cs, and complete your payment.
2.7 To enter an Instant Win Competition via the paid route: visit www.ALESYOWIN.com, select the competition, choose the number of entries, proceed to checkout, login or register if needed, accept these T&Cs, and complete your payment.
2.8 Once your entry is successfully completed, you will receive a confirmation from Alesyo Win LTD.
2.9 Alesyo Win LTD does not assume any responsibility for entries that do not reach us due to technical issues, connectivity, or any other circumstance beyond our control.
2.10 By entering any Competition, you confirm that you meet the eligibility requirements, that you understand you are entering into a binding agreement with Alesyo Win LTD, and that you accept these T&Cs in full.

s3.title: 3. Free Postal Entry
s3.content:
Participants who do not wish to pay can enter via post, providing they follow the instructions below:
Send a handwritten letter by first or second-class prepaid post to: Alesyo Win LTD, 54 Market Street, Eastleigh, SO50 5RB, United Kingdom. Hand-delivered letters will not be accepted.
Your letter must clearly include: The name of the competition you are entering, your full name, date of birth, full home address, a contact telephone number and email address, and your answer to the Competition Question (if applicable).
Incomplete or illegible entries will be disqualified. A maximum of two (2) free postal entries per person and per competition is allowed. Each entry must be sent in its own separate envelope.
Free entries must arrive before the Closing Date. Postage costs are the responsibility of the participant. To be valid, you must have an active account on www.ALESYOWIN.com, and all details in your letter must match your account details exactly.

s4.title: 4. Selecting Winners
s4.content:
4.1 For Standard Competitions, all participants who answer the Competition Question correctly will be entered into a draw. The winner will be chosen live using Google’s random number generator. The draw will be broadcast live on Alesyo Win LTD's official social media channels. The draw will take place within 7 days of the Closing Date.
4.2 All participants in Standard Competitions may have their name and entry number included in a spreadsheet published on the website or shown during the live draw. If you do not want your name included, contact us at info@ALESYOWIN.com at least 48 hours before the draw.
4.3 For Instant Win Competitions, prizes are pre-assigned to random ticket numbers. Each entry with a correct answer is assigned a number. If that number matches a prize, the participant wins. Winners are notified immediately on the competition page and by automatic email.

s5.title: 5. Site Credit
s5.content:
5.1 Site credits may be awarded as prizes or gifts in certain Competitions.
5.2 In some cases, a prize may be exchanged for site credits, where stated on the competition page.
5.3 Site credit must be used within 12 months of being added to your account. Reminders will be sent via email. Expired credit cannot be used.
5.4 Site credit has no monetary value. It cannot be exchanged for cash, transferred, or withdrawn. It is only valid for use for future competition entries on www.ALESYOWIN.com.

s6.title: 6. Who Can Enter
s6.content:
6.1 Competitions are open to UK residents aged 18 or over, with the exception of: Employees of Alesyo Win LTD, employees of any agency or supplier involved with managing the Competitions, or immediate family members of the above.
6.2 By entering, you confirm you are eligible to enter and claim any prize. Alesyo Win LTD may require proof of eligibility at any time.
6.3 Alesyo Win LTD will not accept computer-generated or incomplete entries.
6.4 Entry fees are non-refundable under any circumstance, including if you discover later you were not eligible or if you are disqualified.
6.5 Any participant found to be engaged in fraud, hacking, or any form of interference with the website will be permanently banned.

s7.title: 7. The Prize
s7.content:
7.1 The prize for each Competition is described on the relative competition page of www.ALESYOWIN.com.
7.2 Prizes are subject to availability. Alesyo Win LTD reserves the right to substitute any prize for one of equal or greater value.
7.3 Unless otherwise stated, there is no cash alternative for the prize. Alesyo Win LTD may, at its sole discretion, offer a cash equivalent if the winner prefers.
7.4 If the prize is a vehicle: it will be delivered with a valid MOT if required; insurance and road tax are not included and are the sole responsibility of the winner.
7.5 If the prize is a trip or event: dates, number of tickets, and travel class will be as specified on the competition page.

s8.title: 8. Winners
s8.content:
8.1 Alesyo Win LTD's decision is final. No appeal will be accepted regarding the outcome of any Competition.
8.2 For Standard Competitions, Alesyo Win LTD will contact the winner within 7 days of the draw. If a winner cannot be reached or does not claim their prize within 14 days, we reserve the right to select an alternative winner.
8.3 For Instant Win Competitions, winners are notified immediately via the competition page and email. If a prize is not claimed within 14 days, it may be re-allocated.

s9.title: 9. Claiming Your Prize
s9.content:
9.1 Prizes must be claimed by the winner personally. No third party may claim a prize on a winner’s behalf.
9.2 Winners must keep their contact details up-to-date. Any changes should be sent to info@ALESYOWIN.com promptly.
9.3 Cash prizes will be transferred directly to the winner's bank account. The winner must confirm they are the account holder. Failure to provide this proof within 14 days will result in forfeiting the prize.

s10.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
s10.content:
10.1 To the extent permitted by law, Alesyo Win LTD will not be responsible for any loss, injury, or damage resulting from entering a Competition or using a prize, unless directly caused by our negligence.
10.2 Alesyo Win LTD is not responsible for: entries lost due to incorrect information or technical failures; unauthorized access or tampering with entry data.

s11.title: 11. Data Protection & Publicity
s11.content:
11.1 By entering, you agree that Alesyo Win LTD may store and use your personal information solely for the purpose of managing the Competition, in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
11.2 If you win, you agree that Alesyo Win LTD may use your name and image to announce the result publicly.
11.3 If you do not wish to participate in publicity, please inform us before the Closing Date.

s12.title: 12. General
s12.content:
12.1 Alesyo Win LTD may update these T&Cs from time to time. The current version will always be available on www.ALESYOWIN.com.
12.2 These T&Cs are governed by the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.

Terms.footerNote: Your privacy is our priority. If you have any questions, please contact us.

PostalEntry.title: Free Postal Entry Method
PostalEntry.intro: Any person who wishes to enter a competition—whether a Standard Competition or an Instant Win Competition—can do so for free by following the full set of instructions below.

s1.title: 1. Address
s1.content: Your entry must be sent by first or second-class prepaid post and addressed to: Alesyo Win LTD, 54 Market Street, Eastleigh, SO50 5RB, United Kingdom. Hand-delivered entries will not be accepted under any circumstances and will be excluded from the draw.

s2.title: 2. Information Required
s2.content:
Each postal entry must clearly contain all the following information:

• The name of the competition you are entering
• Your full name
• Your date of birth
• Your full home address
• A contact telephone number and email address
• Your answer to the Competition Question, where applicable

Entries that are missing any of the information above, or that cannot be read clearly, will be disqualified without exception.

s3.title: 3. Entry Limits
s3.content: You can submit more than one free entry per competition, up to the maximum number of entries allowed for that competition. The entry limit per person is displayed on the relative competition page on www.ALESYOWIN.com. Each entry must be posted separately in its own individual envelope. If more than one entry is placed inside a single envelope, the entire mailing will be counted as only one entry, regardless of how many entries are enclosed.

s4.title: 4. Standard Competitions
s4.content: For Standard Competitions, your postal entry must physically arrive at the address above before the stated Closing Date and before all available tickets for that competition have been allocated. Entries that arrive within 48 hours of the Closing Date or within 48 hours of all tickets being allocated may, at the sole discretion of Alesyo Win LTD, be carried forward and entered into the next available competition of comparable value where entries are still open. Entries that arrive after the Closing Date and after all tickets have been allocated will not be entered into the initial competition nor any other competition. Please note that proof of postage is not accepted as proof of receipt and does not guarantee that your entry will be included in the draw.

s5.title: 5. Instant Win Competitions
s5.content: For Instant Win Competitions, your free postal entry must arrive before all tickets for that competition have been allocated by means of paid entries. Providing all tickets have not been allocated, entries will also be accepted if they arrive within 48 hours of the Closing Date to be included in the Instant Win Competition.

s6.title: 6. Ticket Availability
s6.content: If the maximum number of entries for a competition is reached before your postal entry is received, your entry will not be included in that competition nor any other competition, unless the provisions of paragraph 4 above apply.

s7.title: 7. Registered Account
s7.content: To have your free postal entry processed, you must own an active registered account on www.ALESYOWIN.com. All personal details included in your letter must match your registered account details exactly. Entries where details do not match, or where no matching account exists, will be deemed invalid and will not be included in the draw.

Alesyo Win LTD ("we", "our", "us") operates the website www.ALESYOWIN.com. This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them on our website, and what choices you have regarding their use.

By continuing to use www.ALESYOWIN.com, you acknowledge that you have read and understood how we use cookies as described below.

s1.title: 1. About this Policy
s1.content: Alesyo Win LTD ("we", "our", "us") operates the website www.ALESYOWIN.com. This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them on our website, and what choices you have regarding their use.

s2.title: 2. What is a Cookie?
s2.content:
A cookie is a small text file that is placed on your device—such as your computer, tablet, or mobile phone—when you visit a website. Cookies allow the website to recognize your device on future visits and remember certain information about your preferences or activity, such as whether you are logged in or what language you prefer.
Cookies do not in themselves contain your name or any directly identifiable personal information, but they can be linked to the personal data we hold about you in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

s3.title: 3. How we use Cookies
s3.content:
We use cookies on www.ALESYOWIN.com for several purposes, including:

• Keeping the website working properly – Some cookies are essential for the site to function. Without them, certain pages or features may not work as expected.
• Understanding how visitors use our site – We use analytical tools to see which pages are visited most often and where visitors come from. This helps us improve the user experience.
• Remembering your preferences – Cookies help us remember choices you’ve made, like your language setting, so you don’t have to re-enter them every time.
• Providing relevant content and advertising – We may use cookies to show you promotions related to our giveaways that we think might interest you.

s4.title: 4. Third-Party Cookies
s4.content:
Some cookies on www.ALESYOWIN.com are placed by third-party services we use to support our website, such as Google, Meta, and TikTok. Each of these third parties operates under its own privacy and cookie policies, which you can read here:

• Google: https://policies.google.com/privacy
• Meta (Facebook/Instagram): https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/
• TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/eea/privacy-policy/en

Alesyo Win LTD does not have control over how these third parties use the data collected via their cookies.

s5.title: 5. Your Choices and Controls
s5.content:
You have control over how cookies are used during your visit to our website:

• Cookie Banner – On your first visit, a notice will be displayed allowing you to accept or decline non-essential cookies.
• Browser Settings – You can adjust your browser settings at any time to block or delete cookies. Please check your browser's "Help" or "Settings" menu for instructions.
• Changing Your Preferences – You can update your cookie choices at any time by clearing your cookies or via the consent link on our site.

s6.title: 6. Updates to this Policy
s6.content: We may revise this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, legislation, or the way we operate our website. Any updates will be posted on this page, and the date at the top will be updated accordingly.

s7.content:
If you have questions about how we use cookies on www.ALESYOWIN.com, please contact us:

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
FAQ.intro: Do you have questions about how ALESYOWIN works? We've gathered the most common questions here to help you understand our process and how you can win incredible prizes.

q1.question: How do I enter a competition?
q1.answer: It's simple! Choose the competition you want, answer the qualifying question correctly, select the number of tickets, and complete the payment. You will receive a confirmation email with your ticket numbers.

q2.question: Who can participate?
q2.answer: Competitions are open to UK residents aged 18 and over. Please check our Official Rules for full eligibility details.

q3.question: How are winners chosen?
q3.answer: Standard competition winners are chosen through a live draw using Google's random number generator. For Instant Win competitions, prizes are automatically assigned to winning ticket numbers at the time of purchase.

q4.question: What are Instant Win prizes?
q4.answer: Instant Win prizes are prizes you can win immediately at the time of purchase, without waiting for the final draw. If your ticket number matches an instant prize, you win on the spot!

q5.question: When does the draw take place?
q5.answer: Draws usually take place within 7 days of the competition closing. The exact date and time are announced on our social media pages.

q6.question: How do I receive my prize if I win?
q6.answer: Our team will contact you by phone or email within 7 days of the draw to arrange delivery details. Cash prizes are transferred directly to your bank account.

FAQ.footerNote: Didn't find the answer you were looking for? Contact us at info@ALESYOWIN.com and we'll be happy to help.
